data_description.soc_entity: Any sensor with a charge in percent.
data_description.power_entity: Optional. Battery power in W or kW, positive while discharging. Adds the state, session, time to full and measured capacity, and the time left comes from the power instead of how fast the percentage falls.
data_description.capacity: Energy of the full battery (0–100 %), needed with the power.
data_description.floor_entity: Optional. An entity with the charge in % the battery is discharged to, e.g. the inverter's shutdown SOC. The time left counts down to it; while it has no number the last known one is used, 0 % without one.

error.capacity_missing: Set the capacity: the power is used only together with it.

abort.already_configured: This charge sensor is already monitored.
